This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, with enormous heads, with tall, smooth, bulbous craniums, large squinted [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and elongated, drooping probiscis-like [[Mouth/Legends|snouts]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least two members of this species were present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorliss]].<ref name="MJ4" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 4|fourth issue]]<ref name="MJ4" /> of the [[1998]]<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54456/star_wars_mara_jade_-_by_the_emperors_hand_1998_4|text=Star Wars: Mara Jade - By the Emperor's Hand (1998) #4}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]'' series of comics, written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and [[Michael A. Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ4" />
